from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError
from ledgerly import audit

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
def mk(): return Payment("p","i",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured",created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)

# full refund sets status
p=mk(); refund_shipping(p,Decimal("100.00"),T0); print(p.refunded_amount,p.status)
# partial then full
p=mk(); refund_shipping(p,Decimal("40.00"),T0); refund_shipping(p,Decimal("60.00"),T0); print(p.refunded_amount,p.status)
# over refund
p=mk()
try: refund_shipping(p,Decimal("101.00"),T0)
except BillingError as e: print("over:",e.code)
# non-positive
p=mk()
try: refund_shipping(p,Decimal("0"),T0)
except BillingError as e: print("zero:",e.code)
# approval
p=mk()
try: refund_shipping(p,Decimal("500.01"),T0)
except BillingError as e: print("approval:",e.code)
p=mk(); refund_shipping(p,Decimal("500.01"),T0,approved_by="mgr"); print("approved ok",p.refunded_amount)
# idempotency
audit.clear(); p=mk()
refund_shipping(p,Decimal("10.00"),T0,idempotency_key="k1")
refund_shipping(p,Decimal("10.00"),T0,idempotency_key="k1")
print("idem:",p.refunded_amount)
# invalid state
p=mk(); p.status="authorized"
try: refund_shipping(p,Decimal("1.00"),T0)
except BillingError as e: print("state:",e.code)
EOF"}
